turns.text: Hi there! Where do you think we should start with this problem?
Um, I think we split the 18 between the 3 boys? So each one gets 6.
Right, so the eldest starts with 6. What happens to his money next?
He adds 5, so that's 11, and then 10 more the next day, so 21.
Good. Then he spends some of it. What does he have after that?
Now the problem says he triples the amount he had left. What would you do with the 13?
Triple means times 3, so 13 times 3 is 39. So he has 39 dollars now.
Nice. Can you explain why you tripled the 13 and not the 21?
Because it says he tripled what he had left after spending the 8, and that was 13.
